item.title: Version 1.11.0
item.description:
What’s new

New and improved

  • prioritize decision models and expandable shared rules (#183)
  • preserve mixed extraction across decision models (#187)
  • split macOS downloads by architecture with auto-detecting website download (#194)
  • add restrained native HDR About wordmark (#193)
  • add OpenAI and accurate Quick Search totals (#199)
  • add semantic search with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI or local embeddings (#206)

Fixes

  • preserve main CI with an explicit squash body (#184)
  • let Cmd+Backspace clear Quick Search text before deleting entries (#192)
  • release the Intel DMG when the runner lacks Rosetta (#195)
  • harden release notes HTML, Sparkle tool download and received files (#208)
  • unblock Alpha DMG and TestFlight steps (#210)
  • adopt the review submission already holding a Stable version (#214)
  • retry stapler on transient ticket-service errors (#216)

Performance

  • lazy history payloads, 2x faster search, in-place updates; 32% smaller DMG (#186)

Under the hood

  • update appcast for v1.10.0 [skip ci]
  • match exact Apple app and wait for prior review (#182)
  • bump the minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 2 updates (#190)
  • use dedicated Linux machine for portable checks (#200)
  • update Swift packages and landing-page dev dependencies (#207)
  • fast PR gate, full suites after merge; prune tests ~80% (#209)
  • distribute iOS Alpha builds through TestFlight on the main app (#218)

Documentation

  • audit instruction files for current models (#205)
  • point agents at Sosumi for Apple documentation (#204)

Other changes

  • Mask temporary keychain password in release logs (#215)
  • Remove quality-software conformance review (#217)

Full changelog: https://github.com/crmitchelmore/pasta/compare/0bb553db8dfff1dd132727f06550d87267515cea...19904487a47de0512a3bbd69f997504b226eb6e6
